description.value: This Subway franchise, branded 'Subway Metropolis At Metrotown', is located inside the large Metropolis at Metrotown shopping mall on the busy Kingsway corridor in Burnaby. It offers the full Subway lineup of customizable sandwiches, wraps, and salads with multiple ordering options including pickup, delivery, and in-restaurant dining. As a mall-level food court unit, it gives cyclists access to a quick, customizable meal near a major transit hub.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (10 spaces) at 27m; rack (6 spaces) at 43m; stands (8 spaces) at 70m. Total: 24 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Subway corporate website confirms the address (4700 Kingsway Fc7, Burnaby BC V5H 4M1), phone number ((604) 433-4288), and that this location is inside Metropolis at Metrotown mall. The website explicitly mentions 'Order Pick Up', 'in-restaurant dining', and 'curbside pickup', confirming takeout service; OSM tag takeaway=yes corroborates this. Neither the website nor OSM tags mention bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or device charging, so those fields remain null.
concerns: Location is inside Metropolis at Metrotown mall (level 1, unit Fc7); bike access and secure parking outside a mall environment are unconfirmed.
